editorial_omissions.text: In the 2024 Budget, it was announced that companies would pay National Insurance at 15% on salaries above £5,000 from April 2025, alongside an increase in the legal minimum wage for over-21s to £12.21 per hour.
editorial_omissions.reason: Source S005 attributes the 2024 Budget announcements to Rachel Reeves, whereas the article attributes the Chancellor as John Healey in C09.
